description: This file is a shell script that contains tests related to the Git pack-objects process, especially focusing on the reverse index feature. It sets up various scenarios to verify the creation, integrity, and handling of reverse indexes in Git pack files, including testing configurations, verifying in-memory vs on-disk indexes, and handling corruption cases.

methods.name: test_index_pack
methods.description: A helper function that removes existing pack files and index files, then runs 'git index-pack' with specified configuration and additional arguments.

methods.name: corrupt_rev_and_verify
methods.description: A function that corrupts the reverse index file at a specified position with a given value, then runs 'git fsck' to verify that the corruption is detected.
